title: Redaction Proof
user: People sending converted or redacted PDFs who need evidence that hidden text, metadata, and removable overlays are not still present.
smallest_useful_product: A local drop-zone that inspects a PDF, flags recoverable text/objects/metadata behind requested redactions, creates a sanitized copy, and emits a machine-readable verification report.
success_measure: At least 95% of seeded hidden-text and metadata cases are detected in a regression corpus, with no original file uploaded.
constraints: No legal guarantee; retain nothing by default; parse PDFs locally; preserve an audit hash rather than document contents.
